attribution.title: Vondelmonument - reconstruction from photographs
attribution.author: Map Recall; sculpture by Louis Royer (statue); P.J.H. Cuypers (pedestal) (1867); figure reconstructed from photographs by Wikifrits, Ceescamel
attribution.modifications: Figure reconstructed (TRELLIS.2 multi-view) from Wikimedia Commons photographs: "Amsterdam kunstwerk joost van den vondel.jpg" by Wikifrits (CC0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Amsterdam_kunstwerk_joost_van_den_vondel.jpg); "Vondelbeeld in 2019 (24).jpg" by Ceescamel (CC BY-SA 4.0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Vondelbeeld_in_2019_(24).jpg); "Vondelbeeld in 2019 (26).jpg" by Ceescamel (CC BY-SA 4.0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Vondelbeeld_in_2019_(26).jpg); "Vondelbeeld in 2019 (28).jpg" by Ceescamel (CC BY-SA 4.0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Vondelbeeld_in_2019_(28).jpg); "Vondelbeeld in 2019 (29).jpg" by Ceescamel (CC BY-SA 4.0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Vondelbeeld_in_2019_(29).jpg). Decimated to about 6,000 triangles per figure in the kit's material, no photo colour; plinth, pier and setting are the original low-poly kit model.
